Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC follow-up: success criteria & next steps

Hi Jordan / Susan,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about Acme Health's goals for reducing inference latency on clinical summarization and keeping per-token costs predictable. Per our discussion, I wanted to summarize the proposed POC/trial plan and confirm owners and success criteria so we can align on a final readout date.

POC overview (2 weeks):
- Scope: Integrate Redwood’s hosted inference (dedicated trial pool) with 3k representative documents (clinical notes) via secure ingestion.
- Success criteria (pass/fail):
  - Latency: 95th percentile generation <= 400ms for 512-token average sequences.
  - Cost: Per-token unit cost <= agreed threshold (we’ll model with your 3-month projection).
  - Quality: ROUGE-L / clinical QA pass rate >= 92% on your 50 curated evaluation prompts.
  - Reliability: 99.5% availability during test windows.
- Roles:
  - Acme: Jordan (POC sponsor), Susan (clinical QA), Procurement contact for contract steps.
  - Redwood: Marissa (PD lead & PM), Marcus (runtime lead), Neha (security/compliance).
- Deliverables: POC plan PDF (attached), evaluation metrics template (attached), final readout deck.
- Timeline:
  - Week 0: Kickoff + data access + test account provisioning
  - Week 1: Integration + initial throughput pass
  - Week 2: Evaluation, readout prep, and exec decision meeting

Attachments: poc-plan-acme-health.pdf, evaluation-metrics.xlsx

Proposed final readout window: Tue 30 Jun or Thu 2 Jul, 9–11am PT. Please confirm what works for your execs.

Next step: Jordan, if you can confirm data access and preferred readout slot, Marcus and I will lock the schedule and kick off provisioning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and captures our needs. A couple notes/questions: 

1) Success criteria: the latency target is critical; can you clarify whether the 400ms is cold-start or warm (steady-state)? We need steady-state (after KV cache warm).
2) Quality metric: Susan will expand the 50 prompts to 75 and add a few edge-case notes; we'll send those by Monday.
3) Timeline: We prefer final readout Thu 2 Jul 10am PT to give our execs time to prepare.

On provisioning/data: I’ll ask our infra team to provide an S3 snapshot and temporary IAM role by EOD Monday. Procurement (cc'd) — please advise if Redwood's standard MSA is acceptable for a short-term trial or whether you need a purchase order.

- Great on the expanded evaluation prompts — we’ll integrate the 75-case set as the canonical eval.
- Contracts: Redwood can run this under our standard trial MSA (no PO required for the short trial). Procurement team, please confirm if you prefer an executed MSA prior to data access; otherwise we can provide a limited trial agreement.

I've attached an updated POC plan with owners and an evaluation template. Marcus will kick off provisioning once we have the S3 snapshot + IAM role.
